description.value: Ba Le Deli & Bakery is a family-owned Vietnamese delicatessen operating since 1987, known for authentic bánh mì sandwiches built on French baguettes baked fresh in-house daily using locally sourced meats. The Richmond location is one of five Ba Le outposts across Metro Vancouver and Victoria. Cyclists passing through Richmond can fuel up quickly on Vietnamese subs, rice bowls, and vermicelli bowls, with a solid range of vegan and vegetarian choices on the menu.
